definitions.explanation: Without the slightest delay, usually as a reaction to something that has just happened. A more emphatic, somewhat literary version of the everyday word for 'right away'.

examples.japanese: すぐさま⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: When the phone rang, he answered it immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}→救急隊：26173_kyuukyuutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すぐさま⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: On receiving word of the accident, the ambulance crew headed to the scene at once.

notes:
Usually describes an immediate reaction in the past: A⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、すぐさまB. Common in narration and news; in conversation people mostly say ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧ or ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧ / ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: right away; the everyday word, also used for requests (⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧)
- ただちに: immediately; formal, typical of instructions and announcements (⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}して→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧)
- ⟦{即座|そくざ}→即座：11861_sokuza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the spot, instantly; stresses that no time at all passed
